output.description: Moves PDFs of a customer's paid invoices from the active folder into a per-year archive folder, and returns the moved files, any missing ones, and the invoice totals from the matching database records. It also changes permissions, making the archive folder read-only (r-xr-x---) and each moved PDF read-only (r--r-----), with no access for other users.
output.declaring_phrase: changes permissions, making the archive folder read-only
